paper.title_en: Deformations and homotopy theory of Rota-Baxter Lie algebras
paper.abstract_en: For Rota-Baxter Lie algebras, a homotopy cooperad is exhibited, whose cobar construction is shown to be the minimal model of the operad of Rota-Baxter Lie algebras by using algebraic Morse theory. The deformation complex of Rota-Baxter Lie algebras as well as the $L_\infty$-algebra structure on this complex are deduced from the minimal model and the notion of homotopy Rota-Baxter Lie algebras is given as a consequence.
